def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):

    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):

def split_at_solid_row(grid, color=5):
    """The pair (above, below) of subgrackets around the one full row of the given color."""
    r = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if set(row) == {color})
    return grid[:r], grid[r + 1:]

def line_lengths(parts, colors):
    """For each color, its vertical extent (max-min+1) within each part."""
    out = []
    for part in parts:
        d = {}
        for c in colors:
            rows = [i for i, row in enumerate(part) if c in row]
            d[c] = (max(rows) - min(rows) + 1) if rows else 0
        out.append(d)
    return out

def grew_color(grid, base=5):
    """The color whose line grew most from above to below the solid divider row."""
    top, bot = split_at_solid_row(grid, base)
    cols = sorted({v for row in grid for v in row} - {0, base})
    (la, lb) = line_lengths([top, bot], cols)
    return max(cols, key=lambda c: lb[c] - la[c])
